verdict.rationale: Relay clearly offers interest-bearing savings accounts (up to 3.00% APY) and automated cash-sweep rules to earn yield on idle cash (relay-docs-6, relay-docs-24, relay-docs-30, relay-comm-1), but all evidence describes a single-currency (USD) banking product — there is no mention of holding or earning interest on balances in multiple currencies, only mentions of receiving/sending international wires (relay-docs-23) which is a transfer feature, not a multi-currency yield account. Missing for 10: any documentation of multi-currency account support, FX balance holding, or interest paid on non-USD balances.
